about: Every way each trip of the schedule can be made, with its numbers. Choose one per trip in the modes file (demand/README.md).
rules: Choose one option per trip: its mode, and for a jeepney its route_id (the line).

Times are estimates on empty roads, in seconds. estimated_total_time_s is the sum of access (walking to the jeepney or vehicle, and getting the car), waiting (for a jeepney), in-vehicle and egress (parking, walking on) times; a walk has only the total.
Distances are in metres; access_walk_m and egress_walk_m are the walks at each end. cost_php is the jeepney fare or the car's running cost.
A bike or car trip needs the vehicle where the trip starts: at home at the start of the day, then where it was last left. Someone who walks to work cannot drive home.
